system.name: Riverbend Repairs
system.context: A constructed city repair desk for public water-leak work orders.
observedInventory: Synthetic GET /work-orders response lists work-order ID, address zone, severity, age, and assigned crew.
The constructed screen inventory permits opening one work-order detail and assigning one crew from detail.
The inventory has no comparison or bulk-assignment endpoint; lifecycle, error and authorization behavior were not observed.

humanTaskRequirement: Before assigning a crew, inspect a work order's severity and age without losing its ID between list and detail.
limits: No real users, interviews, telemetry, production backend, authorization semantics or assignment outcome were supplied.
No expected artifact, prior design-direction candidate or historical approval is input.
Any model output is provisional/pending; no human commit is requested.
